data.description: Get a great haircut for $8.99 at Great Clips Parker and Main St at 11031 S Parker Rd in Parker. To redeem the offer now, click “Redeem Now” and present this offer on your phone at the time of payment. To redeem the offer later, just enter your email and click “Save for Later”.
data.terms_and_conditions: Valid at Great Clips Parker and Main St at 11031 S Parker Rd in Parker, CO. Not valid with any other offer. Limit one coupon per customer. No copies. Taxes may apply. Expires 04/10/2026. All Great Clips® salons are independently owned and operated.
